GitHub - RvanderLaan/SVDAG-Compression: Fork of SSVDAGs: Symmetry-aware ...
This repo is used for experimenting with SVDAG compression techniques for my MSc thesis. The source code of Symmetry-aware Sparse Voxel DAGs is used as a foundation. It includes A lossy compression format (LSVDAG) that clusters similar nodes together. A cross-level merging approach (CSVDAG) that merges nodes across all levels of the DAG.
